topic: Kizaru's Egghead fight with Luffy works as a showcase for Gear 5, chapters 1091 to 1095: a side point of the long, not its verdict
title: Kizaru's Egghead Fight Was Built To Sell Gear 5
description: Kizaru gets knocked around on Egghead, and every hit makes Luffy's Gear 5 look bigger. Here's the sequence from chapters 1091 to 1095, and why the fight may be built to sell the awakening.
comment: Was Kizaru's Egghead fight a real clash, or a showcase for Gear 5? Pick one and defend it.

lines.text: Kizaru's whole Egghead fight is built to make Luffy look unstoppable.

shot.fallback: glowing Gear 5 Luffy facing a light-speed admiral

lines.text: Chapter 1091. Luffy strikes first, and Kizaru has to block.

shot.fallback: rubber fist colliding with an admiral's guard

lines.text: Then Luffy's Gear 4 barrage forces him onto the defensive in chapter 1092.

shot.fallback: Snakeman Luffy punching a calm admiral

lines.text: Kizaru kicks back at light speed, straight through Vegaforce.

shot.fallback: admiral's light-speed kick blasting through a giant robot

lines.text: Then a giant Gear 5 Luffy grabs him from behind.

shot.fallback: giant Gear 5 Luffy grabbing an admiral from behind

lines.text: Look at what that fight is for. It makes Gear 5 look incredible.

shot.fallback: white haired Luffy glowing with power

lines.text: Chapter 1093, he splits into light and his sword clones nick Luffy's cheek.

shot.fallback: light clones hovering around a rubber fighter

lines.text: In chapter 1095, Luffy's spinning kick knocks him down.

shot.fallback: rubber boy spinning a kick into a light-clad admiral

lines.text: Kizaru gets knocked around so Gear 5 looks like the answer.

shot.fallback: glowing Gear 5 Luffy standing over a fallen admiral

lines.text: Hold onto that beating, because Oda isn't done using him.

shot.fallback: admiral listening to an elder in a marble hall

lines.text: Because Kizaru takes every hit so Gear 5 has someone to beat.

shot.fallback: admiral blocked by a rubber fist

self_check.hook: Opens on a flat claim about the fight's purpose, stated before evidence.
self_check.loop: Last line leads back into line 1: Kizaru takes every hit so Gear 5 has someone to beat.
